column1: # Partition table for the E32R28T room thermometer (4 MB flash)
# The littlefs image is created by the joltwallet/littlefs component
# expects the generic "spiffs" data subtype.  It holds the wallpaper directories
# There is no OTA slot on purpose (4 MB is too small for two 3 MB images).
# Firmware updates are done over USB.
